## 11. On this day in history
- **1963** — The Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty entered into force, outlawing nuclear weapon detonations in the atmosphere, outer space, and underwater. It remains the foundation of multilateral arms control regimes.
- **1973** — US Vice President Spiro Agnew resigned after pleading no contest to federal tax fraud charges, a landmark constitutional crisis in executive branch accountability.
- **1992** — The Vidyasagar Setu toll bridge opened over the Hooghly River between Kolkata and Howrah after two decades of construction, establishing critical infrastructure in eastern India.

## 12. One idea to understand today
**PERM (Program Electronic Review Management)**
PERM is the mandatory first stage of employment-based green cards in the United States (such as the EB-2 and EB-3 categories). The US Department of Labor requires an employer to prove that no qualified, willing US worker is available for the role before sponsoring an immigrant worker. For example, if an Indian engineer at Microsoft applies for a green card, Microsoft must advertise the role locally and file a PERM petition. Suspending a company from the program halts all new green card filings for its workforce  [[Simply Wall Street]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[WSJ]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitAFBVV95cUxPTS1IenFsZDBpd1MwZmF1emxPczFITlpKb19ITWNLZWI2WnJwa3lvS1JEN0JIVWlyd1ktWVUzZkMzZ0d3ZWxqTGNZNC0yWTFrRXZsNEdRdW1CTXBTdjNWVnphVlExUW1hc2dlSW9lc093YVRvRUFud1dEcUVWWHVrRXFuazV5dGVrOHBaX3l5Q2FVbGppUnI3MGxzQTVuWkF5eTBUQlphU202a3ZSME04dHZUMjE?oc=5).
